newsitem.title: USA: Lott says GOP insists on U.S capital gains tax cut.
newsitem.headline: Lott says GOP insists on U.S capital gains tax cut.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Friday Republicans would insist the maximum capital gains tax be cut to 20 percent in a final tax bill.

"We haven't made a final agreement on that," he said about the proposed capital gains tax cut. "We feel strongly about the necessity for a significant cut in the capital gains tax rate to 20 and 10 percent, and we will insist on that in the final package," the Mississippi Republican told reporters.
The House and Senate bills would cut the maximum rate to 20 percent from 28 percent. The rate on any capital gain otherwise taxed at 15 percent would be cut to 10 percent.
